title: The specified sheaf and unbounded derived graph comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:U\to X$ etale, and $c=(j:U\to Z,r:Z\to X)$ a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Define $a_c$ to be the canonical graph-extension map of [def-f7-etale-compactification-graph-map]. Define $Da:Df_{\Sigma!}\to Rr_*Dj_!$ by degreewise $a_c$, the homotopy compositor, and the total-right-derived unit, descended through the fully faithful localization $Q_h$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. Its component at $Q_hK$ is compactSupportComparisonOnHomotopy$(A,f,c,a_c,K)$. The file also defines EtaleCompactSupportCore as the first four normalization fields and EtaleCompactSupportCoherence as its three exact base-change, proper-refinement, and identity equations, using the specified exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. The exchange, refinement, identity and localization helpers are retained.
